plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, says a space rock likely struck the Earth around the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold spell roughly 12,800 years ago, and that nothing could have stopped it. He links the impact to the great flood told of in ancient texts like the Epic of Gilgamesh, the Book of Enoch and the Book of Ezekiel, which would mean an earlier human civilization was wiped out and had to start over.
